publish.description: Publishes a package to npm via OIDC, pushes the version bump + tag to main, and creates a GitHub Release with auto-generated changelog. Idempotent.

version.description: Bumps package version, commits the bump, tags the commit, and creates a GitHub Release with auto-generated changelog. Idempotent.

changelog.description: Generates changelog for a package version. Idempotent.

plan.description: Computes the candidate set of changed packages + dependents (nx-affected → plan). Idempotent.
